title: Update step: move each center to its group's mean

steps.label: Assignments are frozen
Pick one cluster
steps.pseudocode: Take the members of one cluster.

steps.label: Collect the x values
steps.python:
members = [(6, 6), (6.5, 5.5), (7, 6.2)]
print([p[0] for p in members])
# prints: [6, 6.5, 7]

steps.label: Collect the y values
steps.python:
members = [(6, 6), (6.5, 5.5), (7, 6.2)]
print([p[1] for p in members])
# prints: [6, 5.5, 6.2]

steps.label: Average the x values
steps.python:
members = [(6, 6), (6.5, 5.5), (7, 6.2)]
print(round(sum(p[0] for p in members) / len(members), 2))
# prints: 6.5

steps.label: Average the y values
steps.python:
members = [(6, 6), (6.5, 5.5), (7, 6.2)]
print(round(sum(p[1] for p in members) / len(members), 2))
# prints: 5.9
